$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,\,3x+4 \\  & x-3\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,\,3{x}^{2}-5x-10\,\,\,} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{3{x}^{2}-9x}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,4x-10 \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,{4x-12}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,\,2\end{aligned}
$$

From the given polynomial division, we deduce that dividing the polynomial $3{x}^{2}-5x-10$ by the linear binomial $x-3$ gives

- the quotient $3x+4,$ and

- the remainder $2.$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\frac{3{x}^{2}-5x-10}{x-3}=3x+4+\frac{2}{x-3}.
$$
